scenarios.title: 一个集装箱从船到货架（导览）
scenarios.titleEn: One container from ship to shelf (guided tour)
scenarios.description: 一分钟的自动导览：镜头跟着一个集装箱，从班轮靠泊、卸船、堆场、拖车、配送中心，一直到门店货架。
scenarios.descriptionEn: A one-minute guided tour: the camera follows one container from berthing and discharge through the yard, a truck and the distribution centre to the store shelf.

scenarios.title: 平常的一天
scenarios.description: 默认区域、全链路方案、平常的负荷：早上七点半，配送车陆续出发，港口在卸船，物流园在收货。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Default region, full-chain scheme, normal load: 07:30, delivery trucks leave, the port is discharging and the logistics park is receiving.

scenarios.title: 港口拥堵演练
scenarios.description: 本周班轮晚到 6 天，之后堆场停留翻倍：看码头、堆场和闸口怎么排队，调度台上哪些车受影响。
scenarios.descriptionEn: This week's liner arrives 6 days late and yard dwell doubles afterwards: watch the quay, yard and gate queues and which trips on the dispatch board are hit.

scenarios.title: 机场关闭（风暴）
scenarios.description: 风暴让机场关闭 2 天：货机停飞，机场货站的进口板和冷链货怎么办，值班助手会给出哪些建议。
scenarios.descriptionEn: A storm closes the airport for 2 days: freighters are grounded; see what happens to import ULDs and cold-chain cargo and what the duty assistant recommends.

scenarios.title: 高峰负荷
scenarios.description: 需求放大、班轮和航班加密：物流园的月台门和配送车队还够不够，看调度台和分层看板的告警。
scenarios.descriptionEn: More demand, more liner calls and flights: are the logistics-park doors and the delivery fleet still enough? Watch the dispatch board and the KPI alerts.

scenarios.title: 极端负荷的夜里
scenarios.description: 压力测试的最高档，晚上十点半：港口灯火通明、拖车排队进闸口，看整条链卡在哪一环。
scenarios.descriptionEn: The highest stress level at 22:30: the port is floodlit and trucks queue at the gate. Where is the chain stuck?

scenarios.title: 门店早上收货高峰
scenarios.description: 清早六点四十：配送车一辆接一辆倒进门店收货口，停车场里顾客的车也开始多起来。慢速播放看倒车靠台。
scenarios.descriptionEn: 06:40: delivery trucks back into the store docks one after another while shoppers start to arrive. Slow playback shows the reversing.

scenarios.title: 冷链门减半
scenarios.description: 配送中心的冷链门从 12 樘减到 6 樘：冷藏车在月台前排队多久，温控告警和调度台的冲突怎么变。
scenarios.descriptionEn: The distribution centre runs with 6 cold doors instead of 12: how long do reefers queue, and how do temperature alerts and door conflicts change?

scenarios.title: 随机生成的区域
scenarios.description: 海、河、城市、港口、机场、物流园和门店的位置全部随机（编号 3）：同一套系统在另一个城市照样跑。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Sea, river, city, port, airport, logistics park and store all placed at random (seed 3): the same system runs in another city.

scenarios.title: 自定义区域：河口和大城市
scenarios.titleEn: Custom region: estuary and a large city
scenarios.description: 自定义的区域：海在南边、河口和岛屿、干流加一条支流、大城市。傍晚五点半的光线。
scenarios.descriptionEn: A custom region: sea to the south, an estuary with islands, a river with a tributary and a large city, in the 17:30 light.
